reviews.comment: I have a memory issue so the super specific, once mentioned in class, MCQ portions of exams devastated me. I would remember what the readings were about and what was the impact of certain movements. But for the life of me I would not be able to give specific name without a reference. The FRQ were perfectly fine, but I felt helpless for MCQ.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class was chill until the final. It had crazy specific MCQ questions about things mentioned once in class. Overall, this class is fine and London is a good prof, but hope you have an amazing memory for the exams. She doesn't post her lecture notes so plan on going to every lecture or else you'll miss info you'll see on the exams.

Though she is a nice professor; I personally think you have better options. The main reason is her exams are ridiculously hard and very very specific. The 10 MCQ's all based on specific dates and places given outside of lecture and 4 FRQ's, 2 of which have never been seen in class or on HW. Do yourself a favor and take a different Prof.

Dr. London was a great professor. There is one homework assignment each week along with a short 5 minute "module activity". There are 2 midterms + a final, all of which were pretty simple and straightforward. She doesn't take attendance, but she does handwritten notes sometimes, which you will miss if you arent in class. Would definitely recommend

I really enjoyed 301 with London. There were three straightforward exams, and HW due each week along with an activity requiring you to summarize each week's lecture(s). The activities are a great way to get to know her. She may come off a bit cold at first, but her side comments about lecture material/anecdotes are unintentionally hilarious.

She is incredibly condescending and rude. She only gives quizzes that consist of problems completely different than the homework and incredibly specific conceptual questions. Notes and slides are gone through too quickly to properly take notes. Avoid taking her courses at all costs.
